home.title: Convert files on your device
home.subtitle: Everything runs locally in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to a server. Free, open source, and installable for offline use.

private.title: Private by design
private.desc: Files stay on your device. No uploads, no accounts.

open.title: Free and open source
open.desc: No ads, no watermarks, no usage limits.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: Install it on your desktop or home screen and convert without a connection.

home.searchPlaceholder: Search tools, e.g. compress, GIF, MOV

mp4-to-gif.title: MP4 to GIF
mp4-to-gif.desc: Turn a video clip into an animated GIF.
mp4-to-gif.fpsHint: More frames look smoother but make a larger file
mp4-to-gif.widthHint: Smaller videos are never enlarged. A narrower GIF is much smaller
mp4-to-gif.durationHint: Only the first part of the video is converted

gif-to-mp4.title: GIF to MP4
gif-to-mp4.desc: Turn a GIF into a much smaller MP4 video.

video-to-webp.title: Video to animated WebP / APNG
video-to-webp.desc: Turn a video clip into a smaller, sharper animation than GIF.
video-to-webp.seoTitle: Video to animated WebP and APNG converter
video-to-webp.keywords: animated animation clip webp apng png gif meme

formatHint.webp: Smallest files, full color. Works in modern browsers and chat apps
formatHint.apng: Lossless animated PNG. Larger files, but exact colors

video-compress.title: Compress video
video-compress.desc: Make a video file smaller for sharing or uploading.
video-compress.keywords: shrink reduce size smaller resolution 1080p 720p 480p mp4 mov
video-compress.qualityHint: Lower quality gives a smaller file. Balanced suits most videos
video-compress.resolutionHint: Lowering the resolution shrinks the file a lot. Smaller videos are never enlarged

video-convert.title: Video format converter
video-convert.desc: Convert MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI and more to MP4, WebM, MOV or MKV.
video-convert.keywords: mov mkv webm avi flv wmv 3gp mpg m4v mp4 convert format

hint.mp4: The most compatible format. Plays almost everywhere
hint.webm: For the web. May be slower to convert and larger than MP4
hint.mov: For Apple devices and editing apps
hint.mkv: Flexible container. Many phones and browsers cannot play it

video-trim.title: Trim video
video-trim.desc: Cut a video down to the part you want.
video-trim.keywords: cut clip crop shorten split start end mp4 mov

modeHint.fast: Does not re-encode, so it takes seconds and keeps full quality. The start may shift by a second or two
modeHint.precise: Re-encodes to MP4 so the cut lands exactly on your times. Slower

video-mute.title: Remove audio from video
video-mute.desc: Strip the sound from a video without touching the picture.
video-mute.keywords: mute silent sound soundtrack strip audio track no sound

video-frame.title: Video frame to image
video-frame.desc: Save any frame of a video as a PNG or JPG.
video-frame.seoTitle: Extract a frame from a video
video-frame.keywords: screenshot capture still snapshot thumbnail picture png jpg

audio-convert.title: Audio converter
audio-convert.desc: Convert between MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG and FLAC, or pull the sound out of a video.
audio-convert.keywords: mp3 m4a aac wav ogg flac wma aiff music sound extract mp4
audio-convert.dropHint: Works with MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC and video files

mp4-to-mp3.title: MP4 to MP3
mp4-to-mp3.desc: Extract the audio track from a video as an MP3.
mp4-to-mp3.keywords: audio extract sound music video mov mkv webm m4a

audio-trim.title: Trim audio
audio-trim.desc: Cut an audio file down to the part you want, for example to make a ringtone.
audio-trim.keywords: cut clip ringtone shorten start end mp3 m4a wav

audio-merge.title: Merge audio
audio-merge.desc: Join several audio files into one, in the order you choose.
audio-merge.keywords: join combine concatenate append playlist mp3 m4a wav
audio-merge.dropHint: Choose two or more audio files

audio-volume.title: Volume and normalize
audio-volume.desc: Make audio louder or quieter, or even out the loudness.
audio-volume.keywords: louder quieter boost loudness gain amplify level normalize mp3

modeHint.normalize: Brings the loudness to a standard level, like streaming services do
modeHint.louder: Doubles the volume (+6 dB) without clipping

heic-to-jpg.title: HEIC to JPG
heic-to-jpg.desc: Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG or PNG.
heic-to-jpg.keywords: heif iphone photo picture apple png
heic-to-jpg.dropHint: Works with HEIC and HEIF photos from iPhone or iPad

formatHint.png: Lossless, but the file is much larger

image-convert.title: Image converter
image-convert.desc: Convert between PNG, JPG and WebP, and shrink the file size.
image-convert.keywords: png jpg jpeg webp gif bmp avif compress resize shrink photo picture
image-convert.dropHint: Works with PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP and AVIF

formatHint.jpg: Best for photos. Transparent areas become white
formatHint.png: Lossless and keeps transparency, but files are larger
formatHint.webp: Smaller than JPG and PNG. Not every app can open it

image-convert.sizeHint: Shrinks large images to save space. Smaller images are never enlarged

tool.drop: Drop a file here, or tap to choose
tool.dropHint: Works with MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM and other video formats
tool.bitrateHint: A higher bitrate sounds better but makes a larger file
tool.loadingEngineHint: The first run downloads about 30 MB. It is cached on your device afterwards.
tool.localNote: Your file is processed locally and never uploaded.

error.title: Conversion failed
error.noAudio: This file has no audio track to extract.
error.engine: The converter failed to load. Check your connection and try again.
error.failed: This file could not be converted. The format may be unsupported or the file damaged.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Please try again.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot create this format. Try another format or browser.

imageQuality.label: Quality
imageQuality.hint: Lower quality gives a smaller file

tool.needTwo: Add at least two files to continue.

clip.noPreview: This browser cannot preview the file. Enter the times in seconds instead.
clip.invalid: The end must be after the start.

formatHint.m4a: AAC in an MP4 container. Good quality at small sizes, and the format Apple devices prefer
formatHint.wav: Uncompressed. Perfect quality, very large files
formatHint.ogg: Open format. Some Apple devices cannot play it
formatHint.flac: Lossless and smaller than WAV. Not every player supports it

install.title: Install LocalConvert
install.desc: Add it to your desktop or home screen to use it like an app, even offline.
install.iosHint: In Safari, tap the Share button, then choose Add to Home Screen.

footer.text: Open source. Files are processed only on your device.
